12522.name: Cam Ward
12522.headline: Titans' Week 6 trip to Indianapolis follows 0-5 start
12522.news: Tennessee fell to 0-5 with a 26-3 Week 5 loss to Houston on Oct. 11. In that game Ward completed 23 of 36 passes for 170 yards with no touchdowns and an interception, and he was sacked four times. The Titans' schedule had them at Indianapolis in Week 6 (Oct. 18), but this refresh could not find a confirmed Week 6 stat line or result for Ward. Through Week 5, Robert Saleh and OC Brian Daboll had publicly stood behind him, with Mitchell Trubisky as the backup.

In redraft, he is not a starting option until the offense shows it can score. In superflex dynasty, a second-year starter with a long runway still matters, and selling at his lowest value rarely pays off. Hold him, and watch for any benching talk or a 2027 QB draft pick before changing that view.
